description: Overlay plus every tool window. Every window label must match something here — a window that is absent gets no permissions at all, so window.__TAURI__.opener is never injected and tauriBridge.js dies on its first destructure, leaving a blank window. details-* covers the per-fight windows, which are labelled by fight id. map is the Map widget, cubes the Cube Finder widget (powermeter.rs open_widget_window), petpop the pet popup and petmarket the Black Market panel (open_pet_popup_on_start), controls the Controls window and grid its alignment grid (open_controls_window, set_grid).
